newsitem.title: USA: US Gulf spot jet diffs pressured lower, NYMEX dips.
newsitem.headline: US Gulf spot jet diffs pressured lower, NYMEX dips.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials slipped lower Tuesday, compounding the drop in NYMEX heating oil futures to push outright prices sharply lower.

U.S. Gulf aviation-grade barrels for delivery on the 35th cycle of the Colonial Pipeline changed hands at 2.25 cents under the screen early Tuesday, though offers there slipped to 2.50 cents under by the end of the day.
Market players saw no clear reason for the weakness, though some speculated that producers were unable to reserve space on the Colonial Pipeline and were forced to liquidate.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
